# Minsen Home Appliance Factory — Dehumidifier & Air Purifier OEM/ODM Manufacturer

> Minsen Home Appliance Factory is an OEM/ODM home-environment appliance manufacturer in Zhongshan, Guangdong, China. The company supports dehumidifier, air purifier, ice maker, fresh-air ventilator and related product development. Certification requirements are reviewed for the exact model, configuration and destination market; applicable documentation is confirmed during project discussion.

Last updated: 2026-10-21.

## Product Lines

- [All Products](https://minsenair.com/products.html): Full catalog — 130+ models
- [Dehumidifiers](https://minsenair.com/products.html?cat=dh): Compressor 20L–100L/day, desiccant, commercial & pool models, R290 eco-refrigerant
- [Air Purifiers](https://minsenair.com/products.html?cat=ap): HEPA H13/H14, CADR 200–700 m³/h, smart control, disinfection
- [Ice Makers](https://minsenair.com/products.html?cat=ice): Commercial ice makers
- [Fresh Air Ventilators](https://minsenair.com/products.html?cat=ventilator): Heat-exchange fresh air systems
- [Humidifiers](https://minsenair.com/products.html?cat=humidifier): Ultrasonic humidifiers
- [Space Heaters](https://minsenair.com/products.html?cat=heater): Tower heaters
- [Cooling Fans](https://minsenair.com/products.html?cat=fan): Air coolers & fans
- [Air Conditioners](https://minsenair.com/products.html?cat=ac): Air conditioning units

## Destination-Market Programs

- [Middle East](https://minsenair.com/markets/middle-east/): Product planning for Saudi Arabia, the UAE and wider GCC markets
- [South America](https://minsenair.com/markets/south-america/): OEM/ODM planning for Brazil and Spanish-speaking markets
- [North America](https://minsenair.com/markets/north-america/): Electrical, performance and compliance review for US and Canadian projects

## OEM/ODM Services

- Custom branding, housing color, control panel, and packaging
- Project-based MOQ, sample and production planning
- Voltage, plug, language and documentation requirements agreed by destination market
- Certification requirements reviewed per model and market; no blanket certification claim across all products
- Production is planned around approved project specifications rather than finished-goods inventory
